lesson: Do not suppress good trades solely due to portfolio risk; annotate and size-risk them.
EOD files are next-day planning inputs; show target credit/debit and mark pending live recheck instead of hiding candidates because the market is closed.
Missing target debit/credit must prevent green execution readiness.
Reports must show plain-language buy/sell legs and expiration dates, not only OCC codes.
Do not use arbitrary top-N cutoffs to hide candidates or audits.
Do not promote low-quality tail tickers or junk speculative tickers into action rows without strong evidence.
Preserve clear status icons and labels for green, yellow, blocked, and no-action rows.
Major liquid tickers such as AAPL, NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, GOOG, META, AMZN, TSLA, AMD, AVGO, PLTR, SPY, and QQQ must appear in coverage audit when source data exists.
Multi-agent dispatch is mandatory for normal Options Agent runs when available.
